decision.text: Agents.default_task opens the dir for a bare spawn at ai/sessions/<local day>/<caller's session folder if it exists, else spawned>/<agent id slug>/, as the brief says. Alternative not taken: nest under the caller's own task dir (CLAUDE.md: a child task lives inside its parent) because many callers (voice sessions, the Dispatcher) have none, so one flat rule beats two; line 1 still carries parent_task when the caller has one. Skipped on purpose: resume, task:false, STANDING ids, page-bound, fork, and any spawn with its own system/sdk/mcp_servers/empty setting_sources (the assistants, echo, chain, fixer, experts, directory asks). Side effect: a task dir puts the agent under gated_role()'s results-gated spend guard ($2 start, +$3 per result).

task:false needs the tool schema to accept a boolean: tools.js declares task as [object, boolean] and its JSON-schema-to-zod map turns an array type into union(looseObject, boolean). Alternative: a separate no_task flag; rejected because the brief names task:false.
